mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1200K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1200K units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) falls below 4% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200K in a month, the tightening labor market leads to increased wage pressure, driving inflation expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 5% YoY signals strong supply-side momentum, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as firms' increased productivity enhances profitability.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between INDPRO and corporate profitability
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) growth slowing down to below 2% YoY indicates weakening demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as reduced consumer spending hurts corporate revenues.
evidence_refs: fact:historical impact of RSAFS on corporate revenues
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when RSAFS growth slows below 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: The federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeding 5% indicates a tightening monetary cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher borrowing costs reduce economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5pp in 2 months, coupled with stagnant payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth (below 50K), signals labor market weakness, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors anticipate monetary easing.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increase > 0.5pp in 2 months and PAYEMS growth < 50K
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 60d returns in > 55% of instances when both trigger conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 4% YoY, combined with a low unemployment rate (UNRATE below 4%), indicates a strong economy with low slack, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as firms' pricing power enhances profitability.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between GDPC1, UNRATE, and corporate profitability
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.
